faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and tooling cost for FS-044 Jack-O-Lantern Carved Heavy Bearing Fidget Spinner?

faqs.question: Can we customize our corporate or brand logo on FS-044?
faqs.answer: Yes. Note that our factory does NOT recommend surface silk-screen or UV ink printing on metal because smooth, chemically inert metal surfaces lack ink adhesion and peel off under thumb friction. Instead, we recommend two permanent methods on FS-044: (1) 50W Fiber Laser Engraving for monochrome logos (+$0.15–$0.30/pc, $0 setup, 100 pcs MOQ, $50 USD sample fee), and (2) Deep Laser Engraving + Color Fill for colored logos (+$0.35–$0.60/pc, 100–200 pcs MOQ, $80–$150 USD sample fee), where the laser carves a recessed cavity filled with cured enamel so the color never peels.

faqs.question: How are the magnets and hardware secured inside FS-044 for US CPSC 16 CFR 1262 compliance?
faqs.answer: All magnetic and mechanical assemblies (Non-Magnetic (Pure Mechanical / Bearing Action); 1 pcs Precision Ball Bearing , Ø16*ID 8*H 5MM) are structurally enclosed or mechanically locked using industrial two-part structural epoxy (>22 MPa shear strength) and thread-locked fasteners, passing 10× 1.5m concrete drop abuse tests under US CPSC 16 CFR Part 1262 and EU RoHS 3 / REACH directives.
